name: Tomas Tobé - Après le § 79 - Am 50
title: REPORT on the findings and recommendations of the Special Committee on the European Democracy Shield
part_text: 79b. Notes with grave concern that criminal investigations in several Member States indicate that Hamas has established operational structures in Europe involving weapons depots and preparations for attacks against Jewish, Israeli and Western targets; calls for intensified intelligence and law-enforcement cooperation to identify and dismantle Hamas networks, logistics, financing and online recruitment in the EU;
